objectives: Blend three sounds into a spoken word

beats.label: Greet and set up

text: We're going to build some words today.
First, let's warm up our sounds.

beats.do: Have the tile set within the student's reach.

say.text: Touch each tile and tell me its sound.

recovery.trigger: Student says letter names instead of sounds.
prompts: That's its name. What sound does it make?
Watch my mouth and copy the sound.

beats.label: Model blending

media.caption: Model: sweeping sounds together to blend

say.text: Watch how I sweep the sounds together into one word.

beats.do: Slide your finger left to right under the tiles as you blend.

say.text: Your turn. Blend the sounds into a word.

recovery.trigger: Student can't blend the three sounds.
prompts: Say the sounds slowly with me.
Now say them faster, all together.

say.text: I'll change one tile. What's the new word?

beats.label: Read the set

say.text: Read each word on the board.

beats.note: Step through one word at a time; let the student set the pace.

say.text: Pick one word from each column to make a sentence.
Drop the missing vowel into each word.

board.title: The Tan Cat
board.text: The cat sat on a mat. The cat is tan. A pup ran up to the cat. The cat did not run. The pup and the cat nap in the sun.

say.text: Match each word to its picture.
Tap each word and say it with me.

beats.label: Extra practice sheet
beats.do: Show the extra practice sheet the student will complete on paper.

board.title: Sample Extra Practice
board.subtitle: Physical paper worksheet reference
board.text: Use the paper copy. This screen only confirms the page.
